svg.title: rev-phonons-full
svg.desc: Complete displayed range−4to15THz contains all30parent branches. The sampled-path maximum is13.828379431216822THz, not a global Brillouin-zone maximum. All30parent branches interpolated from authenticated compact10x80 force constants with recorded phonopy4.0.1 and15.633302 frequency factor. Standard monoclinic HPKOT path in original primitive reciprocal basis:Gamma-Z-D-B-Gamma-A-E-Z-C2-Y2-Gamma. q1=(0,.5,.25) lies halfway on Z-D; q2=(.5,.5,0) is reciprocal-lattice equivalent to C2=(-.5,.5,0). All12120existing line-scan eigenfrequencies validate within2.616e-7THz, with only the rounded YAML factor difference. Negative branches below−.05THz are highlighted. q1/q2 are selected soft modulation vectors; four imaginary eigenbranches occur at each. No FC,ASR,NAC changes; no distorted-phase stability is inferred.
